# Offline original MSI qualification

The **Windows Offline Original MSI Proof** workflow uses a disposable Windows 2022 runner and an existing successful installer build. It never rebuilds a package. The draft pull request pins the original 1.6.0 installer from workflow run `44768324452`, source `83b0a98b278b98e779842538f811b2c6f5b6b4c8`. After this workflow is available for manual dispatch, supply the original Windows build run ID, full source SHA, expected app version, and expected database revision for another candidate. The original run must have its installer artifacts available.

Setup downloads and hashes each original artifact ZIP, matches MSI and all CAB bytes and Media entries to verified build provenance, and stages the pinned Playwright dependency lock before measurement. A preview execution of the independently scheduled SYSTEM recovery task must succeed before the harness changes Windows Firewall. The watchdog restores the original policy and hosts file if the controller stops. Setup, installation, and network controls are guarded for the dedicated GitHub-hosted workflow.

The proof enables deny-by-default Windows Firewall on all profiles. The only external exception is TCP port 443 for the exact authenticated Actions listener and worker executables, with their control-plane hostnames pinned locally during measurement. It resolves `api.github.com` once online and checks direct TCP connectivity to the same addresses before, throughout, and after isolation. Independent controls run under SYSTEM and the actual ordinary account. Effective firewall rules and the runner TLS connection are checked at each product phase.

The test uses the original MSI with `/i`, verifies product registration, and launches the installed shell and packaged loopback sidecar as a fresh Windows user at medium integrity. The tracked first-use WebView2 journey imports and reviews source pixels, reopens them in the editor, and downloads YOLO. A second installed desktop and sidecar reopen the same managed profile and verify the exact saved image hash and annotation. The interval is invalid if the watchdog deadline is reached or either TCP control has an unobserved gap. Recovery, temporary account removal, and uninstall finish before evidence upload.

Download `ReefVision-Windows-Offline-MSI-Proof`. `offline-install-report.json` records PASS, the original MSI, installed binary hashes, source/test identity, control phases, launch IDs, and persisted review. The TCP control JSONL files, `watchdog.jsonl`, `verified-transport.json`, `verified-payload.json`, MSI logs, and native journey receipt document their inputs and outcomes. The runner already includes WebView2 and Windows components. This is an application and installer network-isolation proof on that prerequisite set.
